card.name: Dental and oral-rinse product text
card.fires_on: Small words, spaces or decimal points inside dental and mouthwash text, just before a dose, age or active ingredient. Examples are 'containing' after mouthwash or gel, and the space or point before a number.

modes.label: Before an ingredient
modes.description: The word 'containing' or 'such' or a hyphen after mouthwash, gel or rinse, leading into an ingredient or example.
modes.example: whitening gel<< containing>> hydrogen peroxide is placed over your teeth

modes.label: Before a number
modes.description: A space or decimal point just before a fluoride or rinse dose, or a tooth-eruption age.
modes.example: Tri-Vite Drops with Fluoride 0<<.>>25 mg is available in 5
